name: comp-54
blurb: Text input with automatic formatting mask (AA99 AAA).
description: An input with use-mask-input applying a pattern AA99 AAA (letters, digits, letters). User types freely and the mask enforces the format.
use_when: Fields with predictable formats like license plates, codes, or reference numbers.
avoid_when: The format is flexible or varies by input.
a11y: Label linked to input. Mask is transparent to keyboard entry. Placeholder shows expected format.
